name: How long does an accessible kitchen remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible kitchen remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessible kitchen remodel depends on its complexity and scale. A minor remodel focusing on specific accessible features might take 2-4 weeks. A full kitchen renovation that involves reconfiguring the layout, installing new plumbing or electrical, and replacing all major components typically takes 6-12 weeks from demolition to completion. We provide a detailed project timeline after finalizing the design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor accessible kitchen remodels take 2-4 weeks, while full renovations can take 6-12 weeks, depending on complexity.
